title: Weekly email digest preference
purpose: Document the requested member control for switching weekly email digests on or off in notification settings, including persistence behavior and the initial default for new members.

scope.text: Members can switch weekly email digests on or off in notification settings.
The setting must persist after sign-out and sign-in.
Switching digests off does not disable account-security messages.
A newly created member starts with weekly digests off.

requirements.text: Members can switch weekly email digests on or off in notification settings.
The setting must persist after sign-out and sign-in.
Switching digests off does not disable account-security messages.
A newly created member starts with weekly digests off.

stories.text: As a member, I want to switch weekly email digests on or off in notification settings.
acceptance_criteria: Given a member is in notification settings, when the member switches weekly email digests on, then the weekly email digest preference is recorded as on.
Given a member is in notification settings, when the member switches weekly email digests off, then the weekly email digest preference is recorded as off.

stories.text: As a member, I want my weekly email digest setting to persist after sign-out and sign-in.
acceptance_criteria: Given a member has switched weekly email digests on, when the member signs out and signs in and views notification settings, then the weekly email digest preference is shown as on.
Given a member has switched weekly email digests off, when the member signs out and signs in and views notification settings, then the weekly email digest preference is shown as off.

stories.text: As a member, I want switching weekly email digests off to leave account-security messages enabled.
acceptance_criteria: Given a member has switched weekly email digests off, when an account-security message is triggered, then that account-security message is still delivered.

stories.text: As a newly created member, I start with weekly email digests off.
acceptance_criteria: Given a newly created member has not changed notification settings, when the member views notification settings, then the weekly email digest preference is shown as off.

edge_cases.text: A member who has switched weekly email digests off may still receive account-security messages; the result of a settings state where digests are off and an account-security message is triggered is not separately specified.

risks.text: If the digest preference is not stored per member, it cannot be restored after sign-out and sign-in.
If account-security messages are routed through the same digest switch, switching digests off may also suppress account-security messages.

success_metrics.text: Observe whether a member can switch weekly email digests on and off in notification settings.
Observe whether the weekly email digest preference is unchanged after a member signs out and signs in.
Observe whether account-security messages are still delivered to a member who has switched weekly email digests off.
Observe whether a newly created member's weekly email digest preference is off before any settings change.
